topic: SP-013 audit lows and ordinary commands that come back opaque
detail: From the third SP-013 security review (all high and medium findings fixed). Left as low: (1) os.Lstat/Stat can block on an autofs or stale network mount, and the 100 ms deadline cannot interrupt a blocked syscall; (2) ordinary forms that are opaque by design and may matter for SP-040's opaque policy: 'for f in *.go; do ... "$f"; done' (loop variable), scripts that start with cd "$(dirname "$0")/..", '| xargs', 'make test V=1', backticks inside a double-quoted commit message (bash runs them), 'echo {1..10}'; (3) npm/package.json/pyproject scripts and 'python -m <module>' code are not followed (RC-38). Decide in SP-040 whether to model any of (2) before the guard enforces. Also: the table case 'Agent has no targets' asserts /etc/x is absent, which is only meaningful on Linux (on macOS /etc resolves to /private/etc); switch it to a path such as /z/x (noted by the SP-013 verifier).
